admin.title: Back office
admin.notStaffBody: Your account is not a staff account. Ask the owner to give you a role.

admin.noAccountForEmail: No account uses that email yet. Ask them to sign up first.

admin.lastOwner: You cannot remove the last owner.

admin.noCategories: Create a category first, then add items to it.
admin.modifiersHint: For example Size (choose 1, required) or Extras (choose up to 3).
admin.availabilityHint: Switch items off when they run out, or set a different price for this branch.
admin.onlyManagersPrices: Only a branch manager can change prices.
admin.confirmDelete: Delete this? This cannot be undone.
